maya: quick flag  promoted v5-int4 to 5% earlier and a couple holdout slices (long-docs, legal-summaries) show signal: higher hallucination and lower exact F1. small but consistent. need eyes. :frowning:
liam: can you share the delta numbers and sample outputs?
maya: pulling the aggregates now. short summary: legal-summaries f1 0.912 -> 0.897 (delta -0.015), halluc_rate 0.008 -> 0.022. long-docs f1 0.784 -> 0.764 (delta -0.020). samples in repo.
deploy-bot: promotion: model=rwd-v5 variant=v5-int4 traffic=5% at 1718599800 by orchestrator.
jorge: was this shadowed prior to promote? what did offline A/B show?
maya: there was a shadow run but it was noisy because the sample set lacked the long docs bucket. we missed a stable slice-level signal.
srijan: first check: decoding parity (temperature, top_p, stop tokens) between baseline and quantized path. we had a decoder patch a week ago that subtly changed tokenization on trailing whitespace.
liam: also verify KV-cache eviction behavior under int4 runtime - we saw rare cache corruption that looks like regenerated prefixes. Could explain hallucination growth on long contexts.
maya: running cache metrics now. also replaying 1k failing requests via the replay tool to dedicated pool.
jorge: what's our auto-rollback policy again? I thought >1.5% absolute F1 on a critical slice triggers a rollback candidate.
liam: the autopilot requires: abs F1 drop >= 0.015 OR halluc_rate increase >=0.01 on an SLO-critical slice, persisted for 30m with p<0.05 bootstrap -> then automatically reduce to 0% at next control tick.
srijan: important: the autopilot only applies if the variant had >=2% traffic and the metric is computed on >=2k examples in the window. Right now we hit the traffic but some slice counts are borderline.
maya: current counts: legal-summaries 2.3k, long-docs 1.9k. long-docs under threshold for autopilot.
liam: in that case manual intervention OK. I'd vote to scale down to 1% and run targeted int8 vs int4 replay and logits capture.
maya: lowering to 1% now (manual).
deploy-bot: traffic update: variant=v5-int4 -> 1% at 1718600060 by maya.
jorge: also tag this model on the "watchlist" with required mixed-precision fallback if we see persistent regressions. Add note: require per-channel calibration audit too.
srijan: good call. i'll start a quick script to diff top-5 token probability shifts for the 50 worst hallucination cases.
liam: can you also check prefix-cache hit rate for those requests and the number of KV evictions during replay? if evictions spike on int4 path that's a smoking gun.
maya: replay started. allocating logs bucket + replay job id rwd-int4-replay-171860. uploading sample diffs + trace logs.
jorge: once we have replay outcomes, run the "smoothed-rollback-checker" locally with alpha=0.01 to see whether autopilot would have triggered. post output here.
maya: replay results in ~20m. will report f1/halluc deltas and attach top-k logits.
srijan: if int8 matches baseline and int4 diverges, policy decision is straightforward: add mixed-precision fallback to runtime config for this variant and require another shadow run before re-promote.
liam: and ping support/eng-ops to hold customer-facing traffic tweaks if numbers change.
maya: will do. updating the rollout ticket now and marking as partial rollback -> probe state. thanks team. :seedling:
